title: Best clarinet players: Baquet, Tio
summary: He rates George Baquet as best; the Tios and Lorenzo are mentioned.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Who were the best clarinet players in the city? You mentioned McCurdy once. Was he one of the best ones? Well, I tell you.
Was Bacquet? Bacquet, I always figured he was about the best. To my. Yeah. Of course, uh, there was another two, what he named? Teo. Teo. He was pretty good too.
There was some of the father, and then there was the son, and then Papa Teo, which was the best one?
Well, I didn't know about different, you know. I just figured that I'd know of one of them.
But I think Papa Teo played with Fess too, down in the district for a while.
Well, I don't remember that. You don't remember him though? No, no, no, no.
